fc0847735045fec7.description: About the Role We are hiring a US Equity Research Analyst to support fundamental research and portfolio decision-making across US-listed equities (NYSE / NASDAQ). The analyst will own daily market screening, build and maintain financial models, and produce written research on companies and sectors under coverage. This is a hands-on research role for someone who enjoys digging into earnings, guidance, and estimate revisions - not a data-entry or reporting job. Key Responsibilities Daily Market Screening & Monitoring - Track US market open/close, index moves, sector rotation and macro drivers (Fed policy, rates, inflation prints, jobs data) - Process daily analyst upgrade/downgrade and rating-change data from sources such as Seeking Alpha, Zacks, and sell-side notes into structured screens - Flag estimate revisions, guidance changes, and unusual price/volume action in the coverage universe Financial Modelling & Valuation - Build and maintain 3-statement models, revenue build-ups, and quarterly earnings models in Excel - Run DCF, comparable company, and precedent transaction analyses - Model forward EPS and revenue trajectories; identify inflection points and margin expansion drivers - Update models post-earnings and reconcile actuals vs consensus Company & Sector Research - Read and interpret 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings, earnings call transcripts, and investor presentations - Cover assigned sectors with depth - semiconductors, AI infrastructure, software, and other high-growth US sectors - Write investment theses, initiation notes, earnings previews/reviews, and thematic sector reports - Track competitive positioning, TAM, order backlog, book-to-bill, and other operating metrics relevant to the sector Portfolio & Reporting Support - Maintain master tracking workbooks for coverage universe and portfolio holdings with defined formatting standards - Support periodic portfolio reviews - position sizing, conviction tiering, and trim/exit candidate identification - Prepare dashboards and summary decks for internal investment discussions Required Skills & Qualifications - 2-3 years of experience in equity research, investment research, or financial analysis - US market exposure strongly preferred - Advanced Excel: complex formulas, pivot tables, data structuring, large-workbook management. VBA/Power Query is a plus - Robust grounding in accounting, valuation, and financial statement analysis - Ability to read SEC filings and earnings transcripts and extract what matters - Transparent, concise written English - research notes must be readable and decision-useful - Comfortable with financial data platforms - Bachelor's or Master's in Finance, Commerce, Economics, or Accounting. MBA (Finance), CFA (any level), CA, or FRM preferred Good to Have - Prior coverage of semiconductors, AI/data infrastructure, or US tech - Experience with Python or SQL for data pulls and screening automation - Exposure to buy-side or KPO research environments (Evalueserve, Acuity, S&P; Global, Moody's, Aranca and similar) Shift & Work Mode - US market hours - approximately 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST (adjusts with US daylight saving) - In-office role based in Visakhapatnam/Hyderabad - Monday to Friday, aligned to US trading calendar What We Offer - Direct ownership of a coverage universe from day one - Exposure to live portfolio decisions rather than back-office research support - Structured learning across sectors, valuation methods, and market cycles .

Principal – Investment Banking Advisory Services | Mumbai

Job Summary

We are looking for a Principal – Investment Banking Advisory Services to lead and grow the investment banking advisory practice. The role will involve deal origination, client relationship management and end-to-end transaction execution across M&A, fundraising, capital raising and strategic advisory.

Key Responsibilities

• Originate and develop new investment banking mandates.
 
• Build and maintain relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, PE/VC funds, family offices, HNIs and institutional investors.
 
• Lead M&A, capital raising, PE/VC fundraising and strategic advisory transactions from sourcing to closure.
 
• Develop and manage the deal pipeline and convert opportunities into mandates.
 
• Conduct valuation, financial modelling, DCF, comparable company and precedent transaction analysis.
 
• Prepare pitch decks, teasers, information memorandums and transaction materials.
 
• Lead client discussions, negotiations and transaction execution.
 
• Coordinate with legal, financial, tax and other external advisors.
 
• Mentor and guide junior team members.
 
• Contribute to revenue generation and overall growth of the advisory practice.
 
Desired Candidate Profile

• 12–20+ years of experience in Investment Banking, M&A, Corporate Finance or Transaction Advisory.
 
• Strong experience in deal origination and transaction execution.
 
• Proven track record of independently sourcing and closing mandates.
 
• Strong network across PE/VC funds, family offices, HNIs, institutional investors and corporate promoters.
 
• Excellent understanding of valuation, financial modelling and transaction structuring.
 
• Strong client-facing and negotiation skills.
 
• Experience managing and mentoring teams.
 
• Candidates from established Investment Banks, Boutique IB firms, PE/VC firms or Big 4 transaction advisory practices preferred.
 
Location

Mumbai
